decisions.decision: Move _startTransferListener() from initState() to inside _startUpload() after Firestore .set() call
decisions.rationale: Firestore security rule resource.data.senderId returns null for non-existent doc → permission denied → stream silently cancelled. Listener must subscribe only after doc exists.

decisions.decision: GlassButton upgraded to StatefulWidget with _isPressed + HapticFeedback.lightImpact()
decisions.rationale: Tactile 3D press feel requires state for animation; haptic on onTapDown (not onTap) gives immediate feedback

decisions.decision: transformAlignment: Alignment.center on all AnimatedContainer scale transforms
decisions.rationale: Without this, Matrix4.diagonal3Values scales from origin (0,0) = top-left corner causing jitter

decisions.decision: acceptProposal converted from WriteBatch+pre-read to Firestore runTransaction
decisions.rationale: TOCTOU: reading mutualSnap outside batch let doc change between read and write; transaction makes it atomic

decisions.decision: New disconnectFromUser(partnerUid) method using WriteBatch to delete both A_B and B_A docs
decisions.rationale: Mutual-accept pattern can create two connected docs; old cancelProposal only deleted one, leaving orphan

decisions.decision: _streamReady flag in _SearchResultTile before stream emits first event
decisions.rationale: Prevents 'Connect' button showing before status is known — could cause duplicate proposal on already-connected user
